dedupe_keys.name: nuclear regulation authority japan accident and trouble information reports under the reactor regulation acts and the nuclear disaster special measures act

description: This NRA index page collects Japan's accident and trouble information for nuclear facilities. It lists reports made under the Reactor Regulation Act or the Radioisotope Regulation Act, the trend in the number of accident and failure reports, reports under the electrical reporting rules for nuclear power generation structures, information on ERSS (the Emergency Response Support System) and report materials under Article 25 paragraph 2 of the Act on Special Measures Concerning Nuclear Emergency Preparedness. The index links to these sections, and the individual reports and their dates were not opened. Coverage is nuclear facilities in Japan. Access: web pages in Japanese, free; no licence is stated. Caveats: the page is a navigation index, so record counts and time span are unknown and reports may be PDFs. It suits event record analysis and emergency response studies for nuclear plants, and no directly related records are catalogued yet.
